blocks.text: מַעֲרִיב לֵיל שֵׁנִי שֶׁל ראשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

וּבְכֵן צַדִּיקִים יִרְאוּ וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וִישָׁרִים יַעֲלֹזוּ וַחֲסִידִים בְּרִנָּה יָגִילוּ וְעוֹלָתָה תִּקְפָּץ־פִּיהָ. וְכָל־הָרִשְׁעָה כֻּלָּהּ כְּעָשָׁן תִּכְלֶה כִּי תַעֲבִיר מֶמְשֶׁלֶת זָדוֹן מִן־הָאָרֶץ:
וְתִמְלוֹךְ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדֶּךָ עַל כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ. כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ
יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ:
קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה וְנוֹרָא שְׁמֶךָ וְאֵין אֱלוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. כַּכָּתוּב
וַיִּגְבַּהּ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וְהָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ נִקְדַּשׁ בִּצְדָקָה.

אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים. אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ. וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת. וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ. וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ:

וַתּוֹדִיעֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ וַתְּלַמְּדֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנֶךָ וַתִּתֶּן־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִשְׁפָּטִים יְשָׁרִים וְתוֹרוֹת אֱמֶת חֻקִּים וּמִצְוֹת טוֹבִים וַתַּנְחִילֵנוּ זְמַנֵּי שָׂשׂוֹן וּמוֹעֲדֵי קֹדֶשׁ וְחַגֵּי נְדָבָה. וַתּוֹרִישֵׁנוּ קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת וּכְבוֹד מוֹעֵד וַחֲגִיגַת הָרֶגֶל. וַתַּבְדֵּל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחוֹל בֵּין אוֹר לְחֹשֶׁךְ בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים בֵּין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּלְתָּ וְאֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה קִדַּשְׁתָּ. הִבְדַּלְתָּ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ:
וַתִּתֶּן־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה אֶת־יוֹם הַזִּכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. יוֹם תְּרוּעָה מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵינוּ. וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן־דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ. וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ.

uncertainties.question: There is a small mark under the mem. It could be a meteg (מַֽעֲרִיב) or just part of the patah. Not settled.
No holam is visible over the resh/alef, so I left the word unpointed apart from the shin dot. A faint holam may be lost.

There seem to be extra small strokes beside the qamats/patah under the lamed, he and alef. These could be meteg or ga'ya marks (e.g. וְעוֹלָֽתָה, הָֽרִשְׁעָה, הָאָֽרֶץ, וַֽחֲסִידִים). I couldn't tell meteg from type artefact, so I left meteg out of the text.
The mappiq dot in the final he looks present but faint.
There are small marks near the segol/final kaf that could be meteg or a stress accent. Not settled, so they are left out.

uncertainties.word: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּיָהּ
uncertainties.question: In this scriptural quotation I can't see any clear cantillation marks (no clear munah, azla, legarmeh paseq, etc.), so I transcribed it without accents. Faint accents may still be printed, especially on יִמְלֹךְ, לְעוֹלָם and אֱלֹהַיִךְ. Possible meteg on הַֽלְלוּיָהּ. The mappiq in the final he of הַלְלוּיָהּ looks present but faint.
It isn't clear whether there is a mappiq dot in the final he.
The mappiq in the final he is not clearly visible, and there is a possible meteg under the vav. I couldn't see any cantillation in this Isaiah quotation.
Possible stress or meteg marks near the penultimate syllable. Not settled, so they are left out.
The dot over the vav is ambiguous between a holam on the vav (מִצְוֹת) and a holam-male. I transcribed it as וֹ.
The first word of the small centred instruction is unclear. It looks like a heth with patah followed by one or two letters, perhaps a final mem/samekh, and may be an abbreviation. I couldn't read it.

uncertainties.word: small-type Motza'ei Shabbat insertion (e.g. וַתּוֹדִיעֵנוּ, וַתּוֹרִישֵׁנוּ, וּמוֹעֲדֵי, הַשְּׁבִיעִי, הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, וַחֲגִיגַת, קֹדֶשׁ, לְחֹשֶׁךְ)
uncertainties.question: The small type may carry meteg or stress marks that I can't resolve at this scan resolution. None are recorded.
There is a single space-like gap before this word in the print. The pointing is confirmed only as far as visible.
There is a mark before or under the initial vav (possible meteg וַֽ) and a possible mark on לָנוּ. Not settled.
It isn't clear whether these are printed plene (with a vav) or defective (זִכְרֹנֵנוּ / וּפִקְדֹנֵנוּ). I transcribed them plene, but the vav/holam distinction is uncertain.
There is a mark beside the yod/resh, possibly a meteg (יְֽרוּשָׁלַיִם). Not settled.

uncertainties.word: מִצְרָיִם / הַזֶּה / זֵכֶר / קָרָאתָ / בִּצְדָקָה / הַמֶּלֶךְ
uncertainties.question: Possible meteg or silluq-like marks under the stressed syllable. Not settled, so they are left out.

completeness_limitations: I read all four images in full and transcribed every printed line on the page: the running head with page numbers, five main-text paragraphs, the small centred instruction, the small-type Motza'ei Shabbat insertion, and the last two main paragraphs, ending mid-Ya'aleh ve-Yavo. The page has no Rashi-script or German instructions; the only instruction is the small square-script line before the Motza'ei Shabbat insertion, and its first word is unreadable. At this resolution I can't reliably tell meteg and stress marks from type artefacts, so I left them out of the text and listed them above. I saw no definite cantillation on the two scriptural quotations (Ps 146:10, Isa 5:16), but faint accents can't be ruled out. Block kinds such as 'prayer_scriptural_quotation' and 'prayer_conditional_small_type' are my editorial classification, not printed labels.
